source_meaning_zh: CoinGecko 过去24小时搜索热度榜；每30分钟观察一次，不是30分钟新增搜索量。默认15币，实际不足则保留真实数量；忽略NFT和分类榜。

node.name: CoinGecko · 热榜上榜加分
node.definition: 每30分钟成功取得CoinGecko默认15币热榜后，按稳定coin ID解析内部资产；每币每轮提交一次+10到total_heat，单笔半衰期30分钟。
node.formula: 取当前UTC半小时槽内首次有效成功快照中的coins，按coin ID去重。唯一有效身份映射才保存详细判定并交给提交评分事件；每币每槽最多+10，下一槽仍上榜可以再加。每笔用原入账时间和30分钟半衰期独立指数衰减，然后由既有统一汇总求和。名次不加权；离榜不新增贡献；失败不当作真实降温。

rule.slot_rule: UTC floor(request_started_at_unix_seconds / 1800) * 1800; retries retain original slot
rule.snapshot_rule: Freeze the first valid successful coins snapshot per slot atomically; retries reuse it. Late responses received after their assigned slot ends are archived without awards; never backfill missed slots.
rule.identity_rule: source_namespace=coingecko and external_identifier=coins[].item.id must uniquely resolve to an existing assets.asset_id. Missing/conflicting mappings stay pending with evidence; no ticker match or implicit creation. Freeze mapping in accepted decision; retries never retarget it.
rule.acceptance_rule: Persist detailed decision atomically and uniquely by source+coin_id+slot+rule version before publishing; retry the saved decision through #3006. #3006 assigns event_key and first accepted created_at; retries preserve both and all decay parameters.
rule.failure_rule: Invalid, failed or late collection yields no awards and retains source health evidence. Successful empty coins list is a valid observation with no awards. Do not fabricate absent coins, debit events or catch-up awards.
rule.rollup_rule: Reuse total_heat per-event exponential sum; preserve asset_initial_score/v1 +100 with H=10080. No whole-total half-life, rank weighting or minimum score cutoff introduced.
